summary: Rewrote ShowDateTranslation.translate() to produce {{ var|format_datetime("ldml") }} using HubL's format_datetime filter.
PHP-to-LDML conversion reuses ApacheVelocity ShowDateTranslation::$charTable directly (public static array, no duplication).
Timezone explicitly detected via params inspection; omitted from output when not provided, included as string or variable arg when set.
No-variable case (dateNow) uses 'local_dt' as HubL's built-in current datetime variable.
renderEncodings() applied to inner expression before wrapping in {{ }}.
Tests in ShowDateTests.php cover all 7 scenarios; all acceptance criteria met; full test suite and PHPStan level 9 pass.

comments.note: Timezone detection design decision: TimezoneInterface has no hasTimezone() method, and getTimezoneToken() creates a default token on demand (mutating the command's params). To detect whether a timezone was EXPLICITLY specified, the implementation inspects the params directly via $command->getParams()->getInfo()->getTokenByParamName(TimezoneInterface::PARAMETER_NAME) before calling getTimezoneToken(). This is a known gap in TimezoneInterface — adding a hasExplicitTimezone() method to the interface would be cleaner and avoid the implicit-state detection pattern.

Encoding rendering pattern: applied correctly following the ShowVariableTranslation pattern — renderEncodings() is called on the INNER expression (without {{ }}) and the result is wrapped in {{ }}. Initial naive implementation wrapped the full {{ ... }} expression, which would have produced invalid HubL syntax ({{ ... }}|urlencode). This pattern should be documented in a code comment or base-class docblock.

comments.note: All 6 AC confirmed via ShowDateTests (7 test cases, 15 filter-matched tests, 112 assertions). PHP-to-LDML conversion verified for Y/m/d, d/m/Y, Y-m-d H:i:s format strings. Timezone string, timezone variable, no-timezone, no-variable, and URL encoding paths all tested.

The timezone detection approach (inspecting raw params rather than calling getTimezoneToken()) is an internal workaround for a TimezoneInterface design gap. The implementation comment documents this rationale clearly.

summary: All six acceptance criteria are met.
Implementation correctly handles all timezone paths, local_dt fallback, LDML conversion, and encoding wrapping.
No blocking issues. Two non-blocking improvement suggestions recorded (TimezoneInterface gap, renderEncodings docblock).

comments.note: Reuse of ApacheVelocity ShowDateTranslation::$charTable is clean and non-duplicating. The 'use' alias (ApacheVelocityShowDateTranslation) makes the cross-syntax dependency explicit. str_split() is safe for ASCII-only PHP date format strings. Exception thrown for unknown format characters with a dedicated error code.

Timezone detection pattern (inspecting getInfo()->getTokenByParamName() instead of calling getTimezoneToken()) is the correct workaround for a TimezoneInterface design gap where getTimezoneToken() creates a default token on demand. The inline comment documents the rationale clearly. Recommend a follow-up ticket to add hasExplicitTimezone() to TimezoneInterface.

renderEncodings() is correctly applied to the inner expression (without {{ }}) before wrapping in sprintf('{{ %s }}', ...). This pattern matches ShowVariableTranslation and avoids the {{ ... }}|urlencode trap. Consider adding a docblock note to BaseHubLCommandTranslation.renderEncodings() to document this contract, preventing future implementers from making the naive wrapping mistake.
All type paths (StringLiteral, Variable, absent) are handled via explicit instanceof checks with no implicit fallthrough. PHPStan level 9 confirmed clean.
